title: Refugees' huts, Taeyonp 'Yong Do · 권리:PD(저작권 만료)
summary: A shanty village built on the beach by refugees in Yong Pyong Do, Korea. An assortment of fishing craft, junks and sampans are visible. (Official History gives spelling on map as Kunpongpuong Do, in text as Yong Pyong Do, Taech'ongdo is not mentioned in work)
